data.name: Gerrit
data.gender_notes: Gerrit is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German name Gerhard, meaning 'spear-strong' or 'brave with a spear'. The name Gerrit was popular among the Dutch and German populations and may have been influenced by the Old Norse name Gjörríðr, meaning 'helmswoman' or 'protector'. The name Gerrit carries the meaning “Power, strength, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gerrit usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who embody strength and courage, and are protectors and leaders in their communities.
data.etymology: Gerrit belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, strength, ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gerrit total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_greek.long_meaning: A name borne by several figures in the Old and New Testaments, including Gerasenes, a region on the eastern shore of the Sea of Galilee, and Gerasene demon-possessed man, whom Jesus healed.

in_latin.name: Gerasimus

in_english.name: Gerald
in_english.meaning: Ruler with the spear, powerful with a lance
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Old German name Gisilheri, which is composed of the elements gisil (pledge, hostage) and hari (ruler, warrior). The English name Gerald is a variation of this, incorporating the Old English word ger (spear) and the Old High German word ald (ruler, powerful).

data.cultural_impact: The name Gerrit is deeply rooted in Dutch and German heritage, representing strength, courage, and bravery. It was a common name among the noble and warrior classes and is still found frequently in these communities today.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual sense, the name Gerrit can be seen as a reminder of the protective and courageous nature of God. It invokes the idea of being strong in one's faith and standing firm in the face of adversity, much like a warrior with a spear, relying on the power and guidance of the Divine. The name can also serve as a reminder of the importance of being a protector and helper to others, reflecting the selfless and compassionate aspects of the Christian faith.
